verdict.rationale: HubSpot's Marketing Emails API documents querying post-send statistics for individual emails or sets of emails, with GET endpoints for listing and retrieving them. That gives a developer programmatic access to email-level performance metrics. Nothing in the pack shows API access to campaign-level or workflow/flow performance metrics, and the in-app dashboards are UI features, not an export path to a warehouse. missing for 10: campaign-level metrics API, workflow/flow performance metrics API, bulk export or warehouse-sync documentation, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull campaign and flow performance metrics through the API into my own warehouse or dashboards

citations.quote: You can also query details about the post-send statistics of a specific email or set of emails.
To retrieve a list of all emails, make a `GET` request to `/marketing/v3/emails`
You can retrieve existing emails in your account individually or in batches
